Downtown.name: Downtown
Downtown.description: Central business district with the Theater District, tunnel network, and dense new high-rise residential development.

Midtown.name: Midtown
Midtown.description: Tree-lined walkable district between Downtown and the Museum District with restaurant corridors and infill townhomes.

Montrose.name: Montrose
Montrose.description: Historic bungalow neighborhood along Westheimer with galleries, boutiques, and steady adaptive restoration.

The Heights.name: The Heights
The Heights.description: Historic Heights district with Victorian cottage stock, 19th Street retail, and strong infill and renovation activity.

Museum District.name: Museum District
Museum District.description: Cultural corridor around Hermann Park and the museum campuses with mixed-use development and stable demand.

Galleria / Uptown.name: Galleria / Uptown
Galleria / Uptown.description: Post Oak Boulevard mixed-use district with the Galleria, transit (Uptown BRT), and high-rise luxury development.
